description: Use this when the user wants to calculate their GPA (gpa calculator, gpa calculator college, gpa calculator high school, weighted gpa calculator, gpa calculator cumulative, gpa calculator with current gpa, gpa calculator from percentage, how to calculate gpa with credit hours or letter grades). Takes courses with letter grades (A+ to F), percentages, or P/NP/W, plus credits and level (regular, honors, AP, IB, dual enrollment). Returns exact unweighted and weighted GPA (2 and 3 decimals), cumulative GPA when previous GPA and credits are given, a quality points table, grade distribution, and the single course whose one-letter improvement raises the GPA most. Standard 4.0 scale by default; A+ value, weights, percent cutoffs, and letter points are adjustable because schools differ. Does not read transcripts, convert between countries' grading systems, or predict admissions.

a_plus_points.description: Grade points for an A+: 4.0 (default, standard 4.0 scale) or 4.3 if the school awards 4.3.

courses.description: The courses for this term, e.g. [{"name":"Biology","grade":"A","credits":4},{"name":"Calculus","grade":"B+","credits":3}].

credits.description: Credit hours or units for the course, greater than 0, e.g. 3 (college) or 1 (a year-long high school class).

grade.description: Letter grade A+ to F (e.g. "B+"), a percentage (e.g. "91%" or 91), grade points on the 4.0 scale (e.g. 3.7 = A-; a bare number up to 4.0, or 4.3 when A+ = 4.3, is read as grade points), or P / NP / W / I for courses that do not count in the GPA.

level.description: Course level for the weighted GPA: regular (default), honors, ap, ib, or dual (dual enrollment).

name.description: Course name, e.g. "AP Biology" or "Calculus I".

grade_points.description: Override points for specific letters if the school's scale differs, e.g. {"A-":3.67,"B+":3.33}.

percent_cutoffs.description: Minimum percent for each passing letter, used to convert percentage grades, e.g. {"A":90,"B":80,"C":70,"D":60}. Below the lowest cutoff is F. Default: A+ 97, A 93, A- 90, B+ 87, B 83, B- 80, C+ 77, C 73, C- 70, D+ 67, D 63, D- 60.

previous_gpa.description: Cumulative GPA already on the transcript, for a cumulative result, e.g. 3.2.

previous_gpa_type.description: Whether previous_gpa is unweighted (default) or weighted; the cumulative GPA uses the same basis.

weights.description: Weighted-GPA bonus points by course level, e.g. {"honors":0.5,"ap":1}. Omit for the common defaults.

name: calculate_gpa
title: Calculate GPA
